-- Cross-border profit by customer region, supplier nation, and part brand.
-- Exercises nine joined relations, selective filters, grouping, and a top-N sort.
SELECT
    cr.r_name AS customer_region,
    sn.n_name AS supplier_nation,
    p.p_brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    SUM(
        l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)
        - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity
    ) AS estimated_profit
FROM customer AS c
JOIN nation AS cn ON cn.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN region AS cr ON cr.r_regionkey = cn.n_regionkey
JOIN orders AS o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN lineitem AS l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN part AS p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN partsupp AS ps
    ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
    AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN supplier AS s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation AS sn ON sn.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND cr.r_name IN ('EUROPE', 'ASIA')
  AND cn.n_nationkey <> sn.n_nationkey
  AND p.p_size BETWEEN 5 AND 35
GROUP BY cr.r_name, sn.n_name, p.p_brand
HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000
ORDER BY estimated_profit DESC, customer_region, supplier_nation, p.p_brand
LIMIT 50;

-- Orders exceeding their customer's historical average, with a late receipt.
-- Exercises a correlated scalar aggregate, EXISTS, and customer-level aggregation.
SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(*) AS expensive_late_orders,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value
FROM customer AS c
JOIN nation AS n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN orders AS o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND o.o_totalprice > (
      SELECT AVG(history.o_totalprice)
      FROM orders AS history
      WHERE history.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
        AND history.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lineitem AS late
      WHERE late.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
        AND late.l_receiptdate > late.l_commitdate
  )
GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, c.c_custkey
LIMIT 50;

-- Large multi-supplier orders without returned lines, ranked by net revenue.
-- Exercises aggregation before joins, NOT EXISTS, and a top-N sort.
SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    totals.total_quantity,
    totals.supplier_count,
    totals.net_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.l_orderkey,
        SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue
    FROM lineitem AS l
    GROUP BY l.l_orderkey
    HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 200
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) >= 3
) AS totals
JOIN orders AS o ON o.o_orderkey = totals.l_orderkey
JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lineitem AS returned
      WHERE returned.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
        AND returned.l_returnflag = 'R'
  )
ORDER BY totals.net_revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderkey
LIMIT 100;
